subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.**

Are you sure __you have go to__ drop her at the airport?

options.text: you should have to go to

solution:
The correct answer is **'you will go to'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined part in the given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• In the context of the question, *"Are you sure you have go to drop her at the airport?"* the most appropriate option among the provided choices is indeed** "you will go to." **
 
• While **"you will go to" **doesn't directly match the original sentence structure, it can be considered a suitable substitute to convey **a future action** (going to drop her at the airport). The original sentence structure appears to be incorrect, and among the options provided, **"you will go to"** is the closest in meaning to indicate a future action.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *Are you sure **you will go to **drop her at the airport?*
